title: Finite normal field composita
statement: Let $K\subseteq\Omega$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and let $L_1,L_2$ be subfields of $\Omega$ containing $K$. Suppose both $L_i/K$ are finite-dimensional and normal, where normal means that every irreducible polynomial over $K$ having a root in $L_i$ splits into linear factors in $L_i$. Then their compositum $L_1L_2\subseteq\Omega$, the smallest subfield containing both, is finite-dimensional and normal over $K$.
